text: Tuesday, after the finding: the cravat recognised, Hunter recovers
why: The catastrophe was Monday night and the body was found the next morning, which is Tuesday. Hunter's recovery and the recognition of the cravat are both stated.
Hunter gives his account after recovering from his stupor.

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — drug the watchman
why: Hunter is certain the stranger drugged his mutton and so removed the watchman; the label only offers this as a possibility.

text: What was in the stranger's paper? — a drug
why: The stranger wanted the boy to have the paper packet, and Hunter was then drugged. A reader would naturally suspect the paper held a drug.
